name: Violife 100% Vegan Just Like Cheddar Slices
whyItWorks: Formulated with filtered water, coconut oil, and food starches (potato and corn). Completely free from dairy, lactose, casein, soy, gluten, and nuts. Melts smoothly on grilled sandwiches without dairy proteins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Place between sourdough bread for a gentle dairy-free grilled cheese.
